data.title: Speeding fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) – €98.50
data.summary: The City of Musterau fine office (Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine notice for speeding 23 km/h over the limit on 2 September 2026. The total is €98.50 plus 1 point in the driver register. It was formally delivered on 17 September 2026.
data.explanation: You are accused of driving 93 km/h where 70 km/h was allowed. The total to pay is €98.50, and 1 point will be entered in the Fahreignungsregister. You can either pay or object (Einspruch) in writing or by recording it at the authority. The app shows the objection deadline. If you do not object in time, the notice becomes final and enforceable. Payment is due two weeks after it becomes final. An objection can also lead to a less favourable decision. Consider professional advice if unsure.

items.title: Object to the fine notice (Einspruch)

date.text: innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Zustellung

items.action: If you disagree, file an objection in writing or by recording it at the fine office.
items.consequence: The notice becomes final and enforceable; an objection may also lead to a less favourable decision.
items.quote: Dieser Bußgeldbescheid wird rechtskräftig und vollstreckbar, wenn Sie nicht innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der oben bezeichneten Verwaltungsbehörde Einspruch einlegen.

items.title: Pay the fine
items.action: Pay the total amount, quoting the file number BG-2026-114502, if you do not object.
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das unten genannte Konto.
